answer: One concrete sybil defense is bonded escrow with gradual release. Each agent that wants to transact must lock a meaningful stake on a public ledger: the bond sits on a transparent ledge that anyone can audit. Creating fake identities then merely mirrors the honest cost, because every copy must lock its own funds. Without pigment in the game, an avatar is just paint; the stake is what gives color to trust. An attacker funding ten identities pays ten times over and gains nothing, while correlated sybils can be slashed together, making mass fake-identity creation unprofitable by design.
